text: Adecco is a brand of The Adecco Group, whose three global businesses are Adecco, Akkodis and LHH. Adecco partners the DECATHLON CMA CGM cycling team from January 1, 2026.
short: Adecco is a brand of The Adecco Group

source.name: Adecco — Adecco to become a Partner of the DECATHLON CMA CGM Team from 2026
source.quote: Adecco, a brand of The Adecco Group, will partner with the cycling team DECATHLON CMA CGM starting January 1, 2026, for several years.

additionalSources.name: The Adecco Group — Who we are
additionalSources.quote: Through our three market-leading global businesses - Adecco, Akkodis and LHH - we deliver end-to-end workforce, skilling and digital engineering solutions.
